rejected.why: Lack of specific diagnostic markers for diabetic neuropathy
Elevated blood pressure is not specific to chronic hypertension
Factor V Leiden mutation and abdominal venous thromboembolism are not specific to chronic thromboembolism
High blood glucose level is not specific to diabetic encephalopathy
Although CD10 and CD19 positivity are characteristic markers for B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, the presence of the Philadelphia chromosome and BCR/ABL1 fusion is more specific for CML
